title: SpawnNode accepts unbounded int32 coordinates; Dist2 can overflow int64 (UB) in the span-validation path
detail: Node coordinates enter the core unvalidated; two int32 positions can differ by ~2^32, so Dx*Dx overflows int64 (signed-overflow UB) inside SpanBetween, which ValidateDraw relies on for the span check. Latent: slice-1 callers pass fixed small fixture coords only.
recommended_fix: Validate X/Y against map bounds (kMapTilesX/Y) in SpawnNode, or compute Dist2 with unsigned/wider intermediates, so the E3-family span check cannot run on overflowed math.

title: FlowSeedDemand/FlowSpawn accept Src/Dst node ids without existence validation; malformed demand accumulates undead packets
detail: Demand entries referencing nonexistent nodes spawn packets that wait forever (EqualCostHops fails, WaitingTicks++), are never culled (cull drops only Delivered), and ride the serialized state every tick. Latent: current callers pass valid fixture ids only.
recommended_fix: When the demand surface becomes external (3.1 catalogs/director), validate Src/Dst node existence at FlowSeedDemand entry and reject/log malformed entries fail-fast, mirroring ValidateDraw.
